text: Enter the lobby through the Episode Gate to create and enter episode rooms.
Quest and episode information can be obtained from guide boards.
Items and TAFF that are unsold, won, or canceled at auction will disappear if not collected within 3 days.
Items dropped by monsters are obtained automatically.
If your grade when clearing an episode is failing (F), you will not receive items or EXP.
You can use the phone for 1:1 conversations with friends, sending messages, talking with NPCs, and more.
If your character becomes unable to move, try escaping with the “/escape” command.
Skills can be learned from NPCs inside the school.
When playing the game, please set a time limit and take appropriate breaks.
